# NestScout Copilot instructions

Follow the [AI working guide](../docs/ai-working-guide.md) and
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
Do not create or modify files named `AGENTS.md` or `README.md` (case-insensitive)
without the owner's separate explicit permission. Preserve the original README.
Target only `manhtu0407/NestScout-Enterprise` (repository ID `1432052547`).
Verify identity before writes and work on a feature branch with a linked Issue/PR.

This is a public GitHub Free repository with repository tooling only, no selected
application stack. Do not invent build/test results or assume paid GitHub features.
Use Node 24, `npm ci --ignore-scripts`, `npm run tools:install`, `npm run check`,
and `npm run verify:negative` for repository checks.

Make scoped changes, protect credentials, and report evidence and limitations.
Do not merge, deploy, release, modify billing/visibility/owner, expand access, or
rewrite published history without explicit human authorization.
Do not treat your own review as independent approval. Use only existing entitled
Copilot features; do not enroll in trials or enable paid usage.
